token_estimate.note: GPT tokenizer approximation. For exact counts use tiktoken (adds ~2s per conversation).

sentiment.note: VADER is fast and license-free. For higher accuracy on technical text, use a transformer model.

specificity.note: Proxy metric only. Higher = more varied vocabulary = more specific (correlated, not causal).

success_signal.note: Regex on last 500 chars of user text. LLM-assisted labeling on a 500-conversation sample yields ~3x recall.

prompt_archetype.note: Run manually: upload redacted sample + feature-table to LLM, request archetype labels, merge back.

embeddings.note: Enable after Phase 3 MVP is working. Adds ~1 hour for 50k conversations on CPU.
